insights.summary: FY26 consolidated revenue fell 29% to ₹688 Cr (Q4 ₹178 Cr, down 45% YoY) because orders came late; operational EBITDA margin was 36% for the year but 28.6% in Q4. The order book was ₹1,336 Cr, of which about ₹1,000 Cr is to be delivered in FY27, mostly in Q2-Q3. Management stuck to ₹4,000 Cr revenue across FY27 and FY28 combined and 35% EBITDA / 25% PAT margins, and showed new products: an interceptor drone (HyperStrike), a UGV (Vrishabh), smart 30mm ammunition and a cyber-security suite.

what_changed.text: ₹4,000 Cr of revenue across FY27 and FY28 combined
Long-term 35% operational EBITDA and 25% PAT margin
New products launched: HyperStrike interceptor drone, Vrishabh UGV, 30mm programmable ammunition, CIWS with AI-Turing, anti-drone simulator
Arms and ammunition licences received; weapon systems to launch this year

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: We stick to that prediction of our projection of Rs.4000 Crores turnover in FY2027 and 2028 put together, so, we are very comfortable with those figures now.

analyst_questions.answer: The order book needs to touch about ₹3,000 Cr at some point; pipeline runs into a few thousand crores (₹1,500 Cr in bids plus single-vendor tenders).
After Operation Sindoor the government prioritised emergency anti-drone buys; simulator orders were pushed back.
Lower revenue on a fixed cost base, year-end incentives (₹5 Cr), higher warranty provisions (₹3.1 Cr), export post-supply costs and R&D.
UTS and ARI did about ₹260 Cr in FY26; about ₹365 Cr expected in FY27 at 27-31% margins.

red_flags.text: Revenue fell 29% in FY26; the ₹4,000 Cr two-year target needs revenue to roughly triple.
Order book ₹1,336 Cr vs the ~₹3,000 Cr management says is needed.
Orders were also promised 'in the first quarter' last year and came late.
Warranty provisions raised for anti-drone systems supplied in FY25.
Working capital at 196 days vs a 140-150 day target.

watch_next: Large simulator and anti-drone orders in Q1-Q2 FY27
Deliveries of about ₹1,000 Cr from the order book in Q2-Q3
Working capital coming back towards 140-150 days

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Combat training simulators (tank, gunnery, naval, flight) and anti-drone systems; new: interceptor drones, UGVs, remote weapon stations, smart ammunition, cyber-security suite
business_snapshot.customers: Indian Army, Navy and Air Force, Ministry of Defence, paramilitary forces; exports to Middle East, Africa, Southeast Asia, CIS
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: Standalone ₹423 Cr and subsidiaries ₹260 Cr in FY26 (ARI ₹131 Cr); order book ₹1,000 Cr equipment and ₹326 Cr AMC
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: Drone warfare, defence indigenisation (IDDM), training needs, emergency procurement after Operation Sindoor
